main_body: A dead/gothic weeping-willow style tree: a drooping dark-brown canopy of hanging strands over a short flared trunk
top_band: none - the column through the canopy shows only dark outline rows and mid-brown strand rows with no lighter horizontal top surface
evidence: This is an organic tree, so the 3/4 top-band contract applies loosely. The canopy is a mass of hanging strands with brown highlight pixels, and the trunk is a short flared stem. No flat top, rim or front face is drawn wrongly, and no receding side faces appear. The scan shows alternating dark and brown rows (L 18/42/74) with no lighter top band. As an organic object it reads as a tree volume, but the canopy top reads as vertical strands with no visible top surface. Strict reading of the contract: no top band, so fail.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours for the references. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, versus 0% for the references, so the outline is a near-black line, not a dark tone of the material. The shading ramp is three browns (L 18/42/74) and the strands are drawn as simple alternating stripes. It is much thinner than the references' multi-green leaf clumps with shaded trunk roots, even though flat-fill coverage is 0%.
